theme_desc: Change the appearance of the application
theme_color_desc: Change the accent color of the application
ui_scale_desc: Adjust the size of widgets and fonts
language_desc: Choose the language used by the interface
window_memory_desc: Choose whether to remember the main window size and position

index_check_desc: Check and repair index files for question banks, wrong answers, and favorites
